news.title: කොළඹ - මහනුවර දුම්රිය ධාවනය ජනවාරි මාසය වන විට ඇරඹීමට සැලසුම්....
news.description:
COLOMBO (News 1st) - කොළඹ සිට මහනුවරට ලබන ජනවාරි මාස⁣⁣යේදී දුම්රිය ධාවනයට සැලසුම් කර ඇති බව දුම්රිය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව පවසයි.

නිවුස් ෆස්ට් දවසේ විමසුමට එක්වෙමින් දුම්රිය සාමාන්‍යාධිකාරි රවීන්ද්‍ර පත්මප්‍රිය පැවසුවේ, හෙට (01) සිට පේරාදෙණිය සහ ගම්පොල දක්වා දුම්රිය ධාවනය ආරම්භ කිරීමට පියවර ගෙන ඇති බවයි.

news.title: New Job Opportunities Expected in Sri Lanka
news.description: Several companies in Sri Lanka are planning to create new job opportunities in the coming months. The new positions may be available in areas such as technology, customer service, finance, and tourism. Experts say that people with good communication and digital skills may have more opportunities to find suitable jobs.

vocabulary.meaning: A good chance to do something or achieve something.
vocabulary.example: Learning English can create more opportunities for your career.

vocabulary.meaning: A job or role in a company or organization.
vocabulary.example: The company has opened several new positions for young workers.

vocabulary.meaning: Right or appropriate for a particular person or situation.
vocabulary.example: She is looking for a suitable job near her home.

vocabulary.meaning: The way people share information, ideas, or feelings with others.
vocabulary.example: Good communication skills are important in the workplace.

news.title: Sri Lanka Opens a New Train Service
news.description: Sri Lanka has started a new train service to help people travel more easily. The new service connects several busy areas and is expected to help students and workers save time.

vocabulary.meaning: A system that provides something people need.
vocabulary.example: The new train service helps people travel to work.

vocabulary.meaning: To join two places or things together.
vocabulary.example: The new train connects the city with nearby towns.
